flows.representativeInput: Fixture project with .claude/agents/opus-implementer.md (frontmatter isolation: worktree) and .claude/agents/plain.md (phrase in body only); worktrees.mjs create for spec 1, then the isolated file removed and create for spec 2.
flows.expected: First create returns warnings naming only .claude/agents/opus-implementer.md, saying a worker launched as it cannot use this tree, naming joycraft-implementer or general-purpose; second create has no warnings key.

observations.actual: pnpm test tests/runtime-dispatch-parallel.test.ts exited 0: 4 of 4 tests passed, including [AC:spec-2-1], which asserts the exact warnings array (only the frontmatter file, not the body-only file) and an undefined warnings key once no file sets isolation. Source read: isolatedAgents reads only the frontmatter block of each .claude/agents/*.md of the coordinator tree (here), and createWorktree spreads warnings only when the list is nonempty.

limits: Gate not rerun by the reviewer; the implementer gate log records it green at 88acf77, and no spec-2 input changed since.
The test covers a main-checkout coordinator; a linked coordinator reads its own tree through the same here value, checked by source reading only.

findings.summary: An entry under .claude/agents whose name ends in .md but is a directory makes isolatedAgents throw EISDIR; createWorktree then fails after git worktree add and the ledger write, so the tree exists but create exits nonzero. Reproduced with a direct isolatedAgents call in a temp fixture.
findings.assumption: Rare case; outside the named check, not a regression of a stated criterion.

findings.summary: isolatedAgents reads only the top level of .claude/agents; an agent file in a subfolder with isolation: worktree gives no warning. Whether the host loads agent files from subfolders was not checked.
findings.assumption: The spec names .claude/agents/*.md, so the top level satisfies the criterion.

findings.summary: This file tags tests [AC:spec-1-1]..[AC:spec-1-3] for the fixes-1-9-3 queue; those ids also exist in this queue (spec 1 of fixes-1-9-4), so trace for this queue lists them as unknown here and may attribute them to the wrong spec.
